emotional_tone: Confident, Clean, Modern, Calm healthcare professionalism. High authority, minimal hype.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Stripe/Linear aesthetic. Heavy use of whitespace to convey premium authority.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Crystal Glass - bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50. Text and links must be clearly legible.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), zero default shadow. Hover: shadow-md and -translate-y-[2px] transition-all duration-300.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Primary: Solid bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50.

components_strategy.hero: Ultra-clean centered or asymmetric layout. Use the abstract 3D tech visual. Top label badge. Primary + Secondary CTA.
components_strategy.bento_grids: Use for 'For Patients', 'For Doctors', 'For Clinics' sections. Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - exposed skeleton borders or strictly aligned clean cards.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn UI base. Minimalist styled inputs, flat backgrounds, subtle focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent).
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react for minimal, technical line icons. Stroke width 1.5.

animations.hover: Subtle transform and shadow updates on cards. Smooth color fade on buttons.
animations.entrance: Framer motion - gentle fade up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) with stagger for grid items and hero text.

images.description: Minimalist 3D geometric abstract shape in soft blue and pure white. Use in the Hero section to establish a pristine medical tech aesthetic.
Clean modern sleek smartphone and tablet layout mockup. Perfect for 'For Clinics', EMR showcase, or Beta Invite visual.
Kathmandu landscape. Use as a subtle, low-opacity (e.g., opacity-10 or grayscale) background graphic in the 'Built for Nepal / Trust' section.
Female doctor consulting patient in high-quality clinical setting. Use in the 'For Doctors' or overarching features section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts via Google Fonts in the main index.html file.
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Rely on border-slate-200 and bg-white to build the Stripe/Linear UI look.
Use React and Framer Motion for layout structures and scroll entrance animations.
Do NOT use Inter for headings. Enforce 'Outfit'.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-style columns; use precise CSS Grids (Bento Box style).
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs, toggles) have 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='hero-primary-cta').
Implement the Beta Invite form meticulously with patient/doctor/clinic role selectors.
Include a Language Toggle (EN/NE) in the Header.
Strict adherence to the neutral+blue scheme. NO neon, NO purple, NO teal.
Never use placeholder images (e.g., via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the URLs provided in the media section.
